Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH team,

Your emphasis on input costs, alongside the head-office price freeze you previously explained, suggests that protecting margin within your approval rules is central to this renewal. We want a lasting agreement that gives you predictable business and supports a sustainable relationship. How can we use contract duration and payment timing to reach an agreement within your approval authority?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW is up +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 430.81 per unit, 90 days payment, 24 months, 4,580 units a year). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your volume forecast of 4,580 units and the proposed 24-month contract duration.

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. As our list prices are strictly frozen, we can only accommodate price adjustments through changes in terms, and internal escalation does not bypass these constraints. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

We propose a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months, provided we agree on a 60-day payment term alongside the 24-month agreement.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months: €431.47 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH team,

You repeatedly emphasise the price freeze while inviting a binding volume commitment; it seems dependable business is where you have room to work within those constraints. We want a stable renewal that gives both sides a sound basis for planning. How can we reconcile the differing payment requirements in your reply within your approval rules?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 431.54 per unit, 90 days payment, 24 months, 4,580 units a year). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current offer stands at a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

We acknowledge your confirmation of the 24-month contract and the volume of 4,580 units per year. To reconcile the payment requirements and provide a better price, we propose an alternative package at a price of €431.47 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
